course_info.faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

catalog_course_description: This course will provide the students with an overview to the scientific study of human memory. Topics that are covered include, but not limited to, memory systems and processes; such as encoding, forgetting; memory disorders and developmental approaches. Everyday applications of memory will also be explored.
course_learning_outcomes: At the end of the course the learner is expected to possess basic knowledge of the main characteristics and functions of human memory: short-term memory, long-term memory, learning, etc.
course_objective: To teach our current knowledge of human memory.
